Zoe F: quick design sync 11 I'm iterating on a compact 'peek' preview for model rows. shows primary perf badge, version picker, and a tiny "+ compare" control. prototype: https://figma.redwood/peek-compact
Ramon: clean direction. notes: 1) badge crowding when >2 metrics, 2) how keyboard focus works for the peek.
Ivy (a11y): a11y baseline: hover-only previews MUST NOT steal focus. use an aria-live polite summary for pointer users. if user explicitly opens the peek (Enter/Space or click), move focus into a tabbable overlay. also give each metric a verbose aria-label (e.g., "Typical latency (p50): 86 milliseconds").
Theo: engineering constraints: avoid reflow on show/hide. use absolute positioning + transform for animations. also debounce aria-live updates ~450ms to avoid SR spamming when hovering across multiple rows.
Zoe F: plan: hover -> aria-live announce; Enter/Space -> persistent overlay with tabbable controls and small "Add to compare" checkbox. primary badge visible, others collapsed behind a chevron. include data attributes for analytics.
Ramon: microcopy nit: change tooltip from `p50 latency` to `Typical latency (p50)` and header to sentence case. small but keeps consistency across catalog.
Ivy (a11y): test cases I'll run: VoiceOver/NVDA hover announce, keyboard open/close, add-to-compare via keyboard, badge labelling, and rapid-hover dedupe. ensure "Esc" returns focus to originating row.
Theo: quick snippet for aria-live debounce idea:
```
let announce = debounce((text) => { srLive.textContent = text }, 450)
```
Zoe F: decision: prioritize keyboard & a11y behaviors in patch; badge collapse behavior next sprint. action items:
- Zoe: update figma + copy (today)
- Theo: overlay + transform + aria-live debounce (PR by Tue)
- Ivy: a11y test plan (start after PR)
- Ramon: badge priority list + microcopy updates

BuildBot: preview available for branch feat/peek-compact 1 build: https://staging.redwood/peek-compact (build #531) :rocket:
Zoe F: thanks team. will push updates and ping when ready for QA. :white_check_mark:
